name: 10m-open-apis-for-ai-agents

target.text: Target: 10 million+ open API endpoints that pass a keyless API call.
target.note: The target of the collection, not the content of these packs.

so_far.note: The owner's figures across every test run so far, given to the build as a parameter.

headline: road
note: On the date in last_tested (IST), one GET to the URL, sent with no key, returned HTTP 2xx and a non-empty data body. HTML pages and empty results did not pass. The format column records what came back. This is a test result for that date, not a promise that the URL answers today. Licences, terms, rate limits, accuracy and freshness were not reviewed. Endpoints are URLs, not separate APIs; many share one service.

packs.forBuilders: Build a weather agent or app

services_tested.line: Across these services: 2.3M tested · 84% passed a keyless call
services_tested.note: Counted over the 9,199 export services that this pack's rows belong to: the sum of each service's own tested count and passed count (a keyless GET that returned a data body). Over every service of the export the same sums are 5,129,846 tested and 3,726,509 passed.
